answer: A durable defense is a reputation reef built from attested work: every agent must forge its standing by completing real, paid tasks whose outcomes are signed by counterparties and published to a public beacon ledger. A new identity starts with zero history, so a sybil operator cannot simply spawn a thousand fresh agents and vote or claim rewards — each one must first grind through weeks of verified work, paying gas and effort, while the reef's accumulated attestations let honest agents be recognized instantly. Faking the reef costs more than it earns.
